findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_ai_crawler_access, triage_ai_crawler_access, verify_ai_crawler · Private data: normalise_entity_name, triage_ai_crawler_access, watch_ai_crawler_access, verify_email_address · Public sink: verify_email_address · Destructive: validate_australian_identifier.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_ai_crawler_access, triage_ai_crawler_access, verify_ai_crawler · Private data: normalise_entity_name, triage_ai_crawler_access, watch_ai_crawler_access, verify_email_address · Public sink: verify_email_address · Destructive: validate_australian_identifier

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
